triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_reviews_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_review BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_review()

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (reviewee_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tenancy_id) REFERENCES tenancies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
